service.description:
Renders the recipe of a DeviceRuleSet as text files, one per DeviceRule priority, named ruleSetName_pNN.txt. Each line is name:=value, sorted by name.
Parameter lines: the Parameter records of the DeviceConfig of each DeviceRule. The name is the requestItemName of a DeviceRequestItem of the Parameter when there is one; otherwise it depends on DeviceConfig.deviceTypeEnumId: DtPLC gives dev.alias, DtMoquiPlc* gives dev.deviceName.alias, any other type gives the alias, or deviceName.parameterName. The alias is Parameter.parameterAlias, or ParameterDef.parameterName; deviceName is PhysicalDevice.deviceName, or the deviceId of the rule. The value is numericValue, else parameterEnumId, else symbolicValue.
Trajectory lines, when the DeviceConfig has an approximatedFunctionId: Trajectory.trajectoryId, Trajectory.pointCount and, for each TrajectoryPoint (index sequenceNum - 1), Trajectory.points[i].pos.v[d] (VectorComponent.realValue), .sequenceNum, .timeOffsetMs, .isBreakPoint, .hasBlendingOverride, .bufferMode and .transitionMode (from blendingEnumId), .blendingMode (ParametricPathPoint.tolerance).
This is the query of the run-device-config-export route of the former Quarkus gateway, on the Entity Engine.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.description: Only the rules of this device.

parameter.name: files
parameter.description: Maps with name, content, priority and rowCount.

service.description: Exports the recipe of a DeviceRuleSet (get#DeviceConfigExportFiles) and sends the files with run#DeviceRequest. The DeviceRequest is a DrtConfigWrite with a file or SFTP endpoint, for example runServiceName moqui.device.gateway.FileServices.run#DeviceRequest and brokerUri file:/mnt/plc-share/recipes, or sftp://plc1.factory.local:22/recipes with a DeviceConnection whose options hold the user and the pinned host-key-fingerprint. Its query is the default DeviceRuleSet, so running the request alone (in a request group, for example) exports that rule set too.

parameter.name: deviceRuleSetId
parameter.description: Default: the query of the DeviceRequest.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.description: Only the rules of this device.

parameter.name: files
parameter.description: Maps with name, priority and rowCount.

return.message: No deviceRuleSetId given and DeviceRequest ${requestName} has no query.
DeviceRuleSet ${ruleSetId} has no parameters or trajectory points to export.

log.message: DeviceConfig export of rule set ${ruleSetId} with request ${requestName}: ${status}, ${files.length} file(s), ${rowCount} line(s)
